# MGRS

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:mgrs`](gmeow-mgrs.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/mgrs>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A Military Grid Reference System coordinate — a geocoordinate standard used by NATO militaries (e.g. '33TWN00020001').

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string); functional

Use [`gmeow:mgrs`](gmeow-mgrs.md) from [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) to [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a Military Grid Reference System coordinate on a [`Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid mixing systems on one [`Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:mgrs`](gmeow-mgrs.md) on a [`Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) whose [`gmeow:geocodeFrame`](gmeow-geocodeFrame.md) is [`gmeow:referenceFrameMGRS`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameMGRS.md).
